**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **Section 14.3 "Liquidated Damages"** is the only LD provision in the Agreement, and it runs **in our favour**: it is triggered by Array's failure/intentional concealment or falsification of safety or efficacy data, and lets Ono elect to continue the Agreement while being relieved of its diligence obligations and benefiting from a reduced royalty rate (p0671). Under the rule's detection guidance, LDs payable by the Vendor to the Customer are compliant and are not flagged.
- **No Customer-payable penalty exists.** Article VI contains only ordinary upfront and milestone consideration; Article XIV imposes no termination payment on Ono (Section 14.5 preserves only milestones/royalties accrued pre-termination); and Article VII (p0463) provides only customary interest on late payments, which the rule excludes from penalty treatment.

This meets the **preferred** position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no edit is warranted.
